verdict.rationale: Shopify markets in-chat checkout ("Shoppers check out right in the chat", "Sell … in AI chats"), and its Checkout MCP documents complete_checkout to place the order inside the agent flow. That direct completion is limited to Token-tier agents granted purchase permission, though. The default path, and any escalation, hands the buyer off via continue_url to the merchant's own storefront rather than finishing in the chat. Live probes confirmed catalog search and cart creation but stopped before checkout or payment. Missing for 10: evidence that buyers actually complete purchases inside ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Copilot as live merchant channels; broadly available in-chat completion beyond trusted Token-tier agents; hands-on verification of a completed checkout and payment.
